name: printer
description:
Print text or check printer status. Use this when the user wants to print something, check if the printer is ready, or cancel a print job.

Examples:
- 'Print this: Hello World' → action: print, text: Hello World
- 'Print the movie showtimes' → action: print, text: [showtimes from previous search]
- 'Is the printer ready?' → action: status
- 'Cancel the print job' → action: cancel

Tip: For printing search results, first search for the info, then use this tool with the results as text.

action.description: Action: 'print' (send to printer), 'status' (check printer), 'cancel' (stop print job)

file_path.description: Path to file to print (alternative to text)

job_id.description: Specific job ID to cancel (for action=cancel)
